title: extensions.software-factory
description: Every key that a repository can set under harness.extensions.software-factory of its qory.yaml, with its shape. A key that is not set changes nothing; no key is null.

remove_kinds.description: Kinds of a short path to remove, by their names in short-path.json.

remove_sensitive_areas.description: Sensitive areas to remove, by their names in short-path.json.

add_sensitive_areas.description: Sensitive areas to add, each with a name and the file patterns of its files.

command_limits_minutes.description: The time limits of the checks' commands, in whole minutes.
